text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said the Malaysian Cabinet has not made a decision on making motorists pay tolls for using alternative roads to the North-South expressway.

-- Acquisitions by U.S.-based insurance sector Aon Corp have raised the possibility of a merger between two major players in the Malaysian insurance brokerage industry to form a large entity. The two players are Inchcape Insurance Services Sdn Bhd and Pernas International Reinsurance Brokers Sdn Bhd.
-- Malaysia will need time to heal the hurt caused by remarks made by Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew, said Prime Minister Mahathir.
